facts.fact: On 24 July 2026 the government announced plans to establish a Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system, a modern digital system recording births, deaths, marriages and divorces, the director-general saying it was important for South Sudan to establish one as most African countries already use such systems; it is an announced plan with no start date.
facts.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system

facts.fact: The planned CRVS system was announced by the director-general of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration as his directorate's, on 24 July 2026.
facts.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (CRVS) system

facts.fact: The director-general said on 24 July 2026 that partner countries and development organisations met in Zimbabwe expressed readiness to support the system with training, technical assistance, funding and infrastructure; no commitment, sum or domestic budget is stated.
